_source: Community-reported (Discord), verified against extracted encyclopedia base + fusion multiplier data — 20 of 24 matched the reported final base damage exactly. `verified: true` = validated flat multiplier with no stat-dependent scaling in its description. `verified: "approximate"` = the description explicitly says the real value depends on your own stats (crit rate, stacking, an unidentified condition) — the stored number is a single reference point, not the true value at your loadout.

Empyrean Wrath.note: All Thunderstorms strike at the same time — a structural combine, not a stat-scaled bonus.

Telekinetic Sword.note: Modeled directly: 6% chance for 5x dmg (at 0% crit) scaling linearly to 12% chance at 100% crit rate — tied to your Crit Chance slider.

Demon Equation.note: Real mechanic is stacking, not flat: every Fireball hit that lands increases damage +20% and size +10%, with no stated cap. 4x is a single reported snapshot, not your actual value — it depends on how many consecutive hits land before you're measuring.

Vortex.note: Every 2nd Cyclone cast combines for bonus damage — 4.25x is a per-cast average across that proc pattern, not literal on every single hit.

Neutron Generation.note: Cyclone's duration converts into an end-of-life explosion — 5x represents total damage across that Cyclone's full lifecycle, not one instant hit.

Plasma Ray.note: Damage = Arcane Ray base × (active rays)^2. Confirmed exactly against reported values: 4 rays -> 144, 7 rays -> 441.

Lightning Bolts.note: Fixed 8-strike count, not stat-scaled. Note: doesn't account for the total burst across all 8 strikes, only per-strike damage.

Inferno.note: Reported as an 'up to' value. Inferno's own fusion bonus is a stacking multiplier ('Max Multiplier: Damage X30') with no clean fixed number, so 3x is applied directly on base damage rather than compounding with a separate fusion X — treat as an upper-bound estimate, not your actual value.

Snowflake Blossom.note: Fixed 40-explosion count, not stat-scaled. Per-explosion damage, not the summed burst.

Origin Explosion.note: Conditional on something called the 'Hextech module' (+25% damage before splitting if active) that we haven't identified in the extracted data — 1.75x assumes that condition is NOT active. If you have whatever that refers to, your real value will be higher.

Hyperion.note: Reported at '8 satellites'. Hyperion's own fusion bonus scales damage with Satellite size dynamically (not a fixed X), so 3.3x is applied directly on base damage rather than compounding with a separate fusion X — treat as approximate.

Avatar.note: Cloaking has no direct base damage in the Encyclopedia, so this can't be computed here.

Heart of Lightning.note: Removes a split penalty, not stat-scaled.

Meisner Effect.note: Per-hit damage multiplier is flat/validated. Its cast interval is a fixed 3s base 'affected by cdr' rather than your spell's normal cooldown formula — the DPS estimate below may be off for this one since it doesn't model that specific rule.

Teleport.damageScalingText: Space Warp's explosion damage also scales 1:1 with Cloaking's own total Duration%.
Teleport.note: Also chains explosions 5x (each at 80% of the previous), not modeled — this is per-hit damage only, same convention as every other ultimate here.

Gate.note: Per-hit damage multiplier is flat/validated. Removes its cooldown for a generation-interval mechanic that scales with cast count and CDR — the DPS estimate below doesn't model that rule precisely.

Genesis.note: Fixed 50-projectile burst, not stat-scaled. Per-projectile damage, not the summed burst.

Age of the Sun.note: Per-hit damage multiplier is flat/validated. Its cooldown starts 1.75s after cast rather than on cast — the DPS estimate below doesn't model that offset.

Destroyer.note: Per-hit damage multiplier is flat/validated. Reduces its base cooldown/duration to a fixed 2s rather than the normal formula — the DPS estimate below doesn't model that override.
